_note: Mechanism: escalating commitment. A small principled stand compounds into daily physical suffering that he cannot abandon without losing face.

premise.situation: A man decides once that lifts are for the lazy and takes the stairs to the eleventh floor
premise.turn: He can no longer speak for the first four minutes of any meeting and will not stop

character_sheet: a man in his forties, short grey hair, creased shirt, no jacket

beats.text: A man at my work decided lifts were for the lazy.
He said it once, out loud, in front of people. That was the mistake.
Our office is on the eleventh floor.
He now arrives at every meeting holding the doorframe.
For the first four minutes he cannot form a sentence. He just nods.
Someone asked if he was alright and he gave a thumbs up. Only a thumbs up.
That was eight months ago. He has never taken the lift.
